segments.orig:
nemase-tê gaospeñta nemase-tê gaosh hudå
nemase-tê frâdheñte nemase-tê varedheñte
nemase-tê dâthrô baxtem vahishtâi ashaone
anazãthâi ashaone ýâ jahi mereñcaite
ashemaokhô anashava mashyasca drvå sâsta.
segments.en:
Hail, bounteous bull! Hail to thee, beneficent bull! Hail
to thee, who makest increase! Hail to thee, who makest growth! 
Hail to thee, who dost bestow his part upon the righteous
faithful, and wilt bestow it on the faithful yet unborn! Hail to
thee, whom the Jahi kills, and the ungodly Ashemaogha, and the
wicked tyrant.

segments.orig:
ýayata dunma ýayata frâ-âpem nyâpem
upa-âpem hazangrô-vârayô baêvare-vârascit
mruyå ashâum zarathushtra, ýaskahe apanashtahe
mahrkahe apanashtahe jaini-ýaskahe apanashtahe jaini-mahrkahe
apanashtahe gadhahe apa-gadhahe apanashtahe.
segments.en:
'Come, come on, O clouds, from up above, down on the earth,
by thousands of drops, by myriads of drops:' thus say, O holy
Zarathushtra! 'to destroy sickness, to destroy death, to destroy
the sickness that kills, to destroy death that kills, to destroy
Gadha and Apagadha.

segments.orig:
ýezi uzîrô-hva mereñcaite arezahva
bishazyât ýezi arezahva mereñcaite xshapô-hva
bishazyât ýezi xshapô- hva mereñcaite
ushahva bishazyât vî-vâreñti vî-vârâhu
nava âfsh nava zå nava urvarå nava baêshazå
navata baêshaza-kesha.
segments.en:
'If death come after noon, may healing come at eve!
'If death come at eve, may healing come at night!
'If death come at night, may healing come at dawn!
'And showers shower down new water, new earth, new plants,
new healing powers, and new healing.
 
 IIIa.

segments.orig:
ýatha zrayô vouru-kashem apô asti hañjakhmanem
usihishta hãm-ýaêtånghô ýaonemca
avi zãmca zãmca avi ýaonemca usihishta pâiri-haêzanguha
ýehe zãthaêca vaxshaêca ýaonem
dadhât ahurô mazdå!
segments.en:
'As the sea Vouru-kasha is the gathering place of the
waters, rising up and going down, up the aerial way and down the
earth, down the earth and up the aerial way: thus rise up and
roll along! thou in whose rising and growing Ahura Mazda made the
aerial way.

segments.orig:
uzayara uzîra hvarexshaêta aurvat-aspa tarasca
harãm berezaitîm raoxshnem kerenavâhi dâmahva
temcit uzîra
ýezi ahi garô deretem
mazdadhâtem paiti pañtãm
bakhô-baxtem paiti ýaonem
frathwarshtem paiti âfeñtem.
segments.en:
'Up! rise up and roll along! thou swift-horsed Sun, above
Hara Berezaiti, and produce light for the world (and mayst thou
[O man!] rise up there, if thou art to abide in Garo-nmanem),
along the path made by Mazda, along the way made by the gods, the
watery way they opened.

segments.orig:
[âat ana parô dush-kereta] âat ana parô
mãthrô speñtô, frâ-tê zãthemca
vaxshathemca azem idha frasnayeni frâ tê kehrpemca
tevîshîmca ýaozhdathâni kerenaomi thwãm
hacat-puthrãm hacat-paêmanyãm.
segments.en:
'And the Holy Word [manthra spenta] shall keep away the evil: Of thee [O
child!] I will cleanse the birth and growth; of thee [O woman!] I
will make the body and the strength pure; I make thee rich in
children and rich in milk;

segments.orig:
kâravaiti paêmavaiti xshviptavaiti raokhnavaiti
mazgavaiti frazaiñtivaiti frâ-tê hazangrem
xãm azem idha frasnayeni gaodhanem avi hañtacinå
ýat asti puthrahe thrimô.
segments.en:
'Rich in seed, in milk, in fat, in marrow, and in
offspring. I shall bring to thee a thousand pure springs,
running towards the pastures that give food to the child.

segments.orig:

vaxshaêca zãm dadhât ahurô mazdå!

'As the sea Vouru-kasha is the gathering place of the

earth, down the earth and up the aerial way:
'Thus rise up and roll along! thou in whose rising and
growing Ahura Mazda made the earth.

segments.en:
'Up! rise up, thou Moon, that dost keep in thee the seed of

world (and mayst thou [O man!] rise up there, if thou art to
abide in Garo-nmanem), along the path made by Mazda, along the
way made by the gods, the watery way they opened.

'Thus rise up and roll along! ye in whose rising and growing

segments.orig:
uzayara uzîra paxrushta hî kaxuzhi paxrushta hî
ayehye paxrushta hî ýâtumaiti jahi.
segments.en:
'In your rising away will the Kahvuzi fly and cry, away
will the Ayehi fly and cry, away will the Jahi who follows the
Yatu, fly and cry.
[18. 'I drive away Ishire and I drive away Aghuire; I drive away
Aghra and I drive away Ughra; I drive away sickness and I drive
away death; I drive away pain and I drive away fever; I drive
away Sarana and I drive away Sarastya. I drive away Azana and I
drive away Azahva; I drive away Kurugha and I drive away
Azhivaka; l drive away Duruka and I drive away Astairya; I drive
away the evil eye, rottenness, and infection which Angra Mainyu
has created against the bodies of mortals.

segments.orig:
paiti-perene ashire ... astvaitîsh ashahe!
ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'I drive away all manner of sickness and death, all the
Yatus and Pairikas, and all the wicked Jainis.
' A Airyema ishyo :-
May the vow-fulfilling Airyaman come
here, for the men and women of Zarathushtra to rejoice, for
Vohu-mano to rejoice; with the desirable reward that Religion
deserves. I solicit for holiness that boon that is vouchsafed by
Ahura!
'May the vow-fulfilling Airyaman smite all manner of
sickness and death, all the Yatus and Pairikas, and all the
wicked Jainis.
' Yatha ahu vairyo :-
The will of the Lord is the law of righteousness!
' Kem-na mazda :-
What protector hast thou given unto me ... ?
'Ke verethrem-ja:- Who is the victorious who will protect
thy teaching ... ?
'Keep us from our hater, O Mazda and Armaiti Spenta! 
Perish, O fiendish Druj! Perish, O brood of the fiend! Perish,
O world of the fiend! Perish away, O Druj! Perish away to the
regions of the north, never more to give unto death the living
world of Righteousness!]
